_comment: Merged-memory dreams with the contrastive chaining loss, for the GPU test of cg26r. Keys starting with _ are ignored by scripts/merge_overrides.py.
_inf_sup_lr_abs: absolute rate for the phase (local: 3e-4 for 200 steps and 1e-4 for 120 steps over all weights cost +0.12 to +0.15 BPC and were rolled back)
_inf_sup_retry: after a sleep is rolled back by the brake, retry from the same weights at a third of the rate, up to twice (1e-4, 3.3e-5, 1.1e-5); on the GPU the kv set is 42.6M parameters and 1e-4 x 120 steps cost +0.046 BPC on the visited domain
_inf_sup_wgrad: the premise reads keep their gradient, so the premises can be written in a chainable form
_inf_sup_params: only the delta blocks' key and value projections are trained (local: kept at +0.01 to +0.02 BPC)
_inf_sup_chain_mode: contrastive: the value returned for A must pick out its own bridge key among the batch's bridges (local: own-bridge retrieval 0.21 -> 0.52 after one sleep; a plain cosine loss raised every bridge alike)
_inf_kgx_hold: every third chain is never concluded, so held-out composition (GRAPH INTO WEIGHTS 5) can be measured; this lowers written-wording recall compared with cg26q
